meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 激活高强度工作模式,让 AI 助手在会话中遵循你的全部规则。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你使用 Codex 编程,并希望 AI 严格按你的规则执行。
copy.tagline_en: Turn on power mode to make the AI follow all your rules for the rest of the task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and want your AI to strictly follow your working guidelines.

howto.what: 进入 ultrawork 模式后，Claude 会先宣称该模式已启用，然后按严格流程工作：先列出详尽计划，通过注册目标、记事本记录和实时待办清单跟踪每一步；每个任务先用测试证明会失败，再实现到测试通过，并留下真实运行证据。
howto.when: 当你的消息里出现“ultrawork”或“ulw”时触发。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式帮我修复登录报错，并给出测试证据。
say.note: Claude 会先注册目标并写失败测试，再修复到通过。

say.text: 以 ulw 方式实现用户注册接口，先写失败测试再改代码。
say.note: 它按 HEAVY 流程执行，先验证失败再实现。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork，重构这段代码并保留前后证据。
say.note: 重构会由测试驱动，并留真实运行证明。

howto.what_en: In ultrawork mode Claude first prints 'ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!', then registers a goal, keeps a notepad, plans each step, writes failing-first tests, implements until they pass, captures real evidence, and updates todos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the prompt contains 'ultrawork' or 'ulw'; the omo hook injects a bootstrap pointing to this file.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode to fix the login error and provide test proof.
say_en.note: Goal is registered and a failing test is written before the fix.

say_en.text: With ulw, implement the user registration API, tests first.
say_en.note: Follows the HEAVY workflow: failing test before implementation.

say_en.text: Turn on ultrawork, refactor this code and keep evidence.
say_en.note: Refactor is test-driven and verified with real-surface proof.
